'''Jumara''' is the second month in the [[Farede calendar]]. In most years, it is equivalent to the real world period from [[January]] [[January 19|19]] to [[February]] [[February 15|15]]. [[Chansein]] occurs on the 3rd of Jumara and the [[Feast of Abram]] occurs on the 9th.
